scope: Read-only public metadata, immutable dataset card, publisher static documentation and CC BY4 legal code. No NFL CSV values/outcomes inspected or scored by this verifier; no provider odds endpoints, keys, signup, paid acquisition, fitting or C edits.

conditions: Retain PropLine creator credit, source dataset/revision URL, license link and supplied notices in retained source/evidence and published derivatives.
Identify C normalization/filtering/joining/recomputed grading as modifications; retain original licensed source bytes and hash separately where admitted.
Do not imply PropLine, a sportsbook or a league endorses C or its forecasts.
The license concerns licensable rights in this published sample; it does not authorize separate acquisition or redistribution of arbitrary API exports, keys, bookmaker feeds or unrelated datasets.

terms_reconciliation.material_issue: General API redistribution language is restrictive, but this independently published pinned sample has a specific explicit CC BY4 grant. No text found explicitly revoking or excluding that sample license.
terms_reconciliation.decision: Use only the pinned HF sample via its public grant. Do not reinterpret that grant as permission for paid/keyed bulk API exports or change frozen legacy source gates.
terms_reconciliation.minimum_owner_decision_for_sample_rights: NONE: existing public sample license supplies the grant; comply with attribution and retain exact source scope.

publisher_claims: Odds polled roughly60seconds pregame and30seconds in play with recorded changes archived.
PropLine supplies its own grading against league/federation feeds; football grading described as using ESPN.
Pinned card describes one row per priced outcome, one side/line/book; NFL markets listed are passing yards, rushing yards, receiving yards, receptions.
independently_verified: Publisher documentation text and source clocks
not_established: Independent audit of raw bookmaker collection contracts and every upstream sublicensing chain
Historic accuracy or stability of the publisher pipeline before this current documentation
Any real-line predictive result for C
provenance.conflict_assessment: No specific evidence identified that invalidates the explicit sample grant. Publisher use of ESPN for statistical grading does not grant C new direct ESPN/Sleeper access or upgrade held sources. Qualify C labels independently.

line.definition: General recorded outcome line; card labels it The line. Last-price fields are price_american/price_decimal.
line.clock: No dedicated line observation/quote clock is documented in the sample columns.
line.allowed_claim: Actual-line statistical diagnostic after row/identity/contract qualification.
line.disallowed_claim: Do not call it pregame, closing, fresh at a forecast cutoff or paired with closing_at merely because the row contains closing fields.

closing_point.definition: Line paired with closing_price, with closing_at described as last recorded snapshot at or before commence_time.
documentation: Publisher docs Opening & Closing Lines / CLV heading and Bulk Export text
closing_point.clock: Archive snapshot recorded_at, per current documentation; bookmaker-native quote timestamp may be absent.
closing_point.allowed_claim: Documented historical archive reconstruction, after validating each closing_at<=commence_time and exact field pairing.
limitations: Current/revised source downloaded after events, not authenticated original C issuance or immutable pregame evidence.
Last retained snapshot may be stale; calculate/disclose snapshot age rather than assume close freshness.
Does not establish bookmaker settlement or complete offer lifecycle.

opening_point.definition: First archived snapshot in the14days before kickoff for this export, not necessarily original market opening.
opening_point.clock: opening_at pairs with opening_point/opening_price; validate each origin separately.

resolved_at.definition: Time PropLine graded the row, not offer observation or pregame availability.

player_id.definition: Card calls it league ID; actual NFL namespace, uniqueness and GSIS/event mapping remain to be checked from the file, not assumed.

resolution.definition: Publisher grading against official stats; not each book house rules; void usually means player did not play.
resolution.use: Retain publisher grade as source evidence, independently reconcile labels/participation and selected-side boundaries for admitted C rows.

prices.definition: Last observed prices may be different from closing_price. DFS labels may contain synthetic even-money pricing or per-pick multipliers.
prices.use: No payout/EV/ROI/CLV claim until exact clock/line/side/price/contract pairing and product-specific payout evidence qualify. Individual statistical direction need not await prices.

timing_tiers.original_C_forecasts: Retained C forecast issue/cutoff/history evidence remains separate; importing postgame-graded source does not recover original prop selections

minimum_remaining_inputs: Root inventory of exact NFL file/revision/hash/columns/season/week/book/market and row coverage before feasibility pilot grading.
Exclude/report any Watermark synthetic canary rows if present; never count them as football observations. Do not alter or hide ordinary API-export restrictions.
Exact native identity/event/role and full-game/overtime/scoring contract qualification; no guessed name-only joins.
Frozen source-feasibility pilot membership and comparator/line/side snapshot policy before inspecting C performance; repeated book/line sides are not independent outcomes.
Independent official label/version/played-zero/DNP/unknown reconciliation and recomputed win/loss/push boundaries.
Original retained C method/cutoff/mask binding; same supported actual offers per comparison and no unqualified timing upgrade.
